nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the malloc_size_of crate, declaring dependencies on app_units, cssparser, selectors, servo_arc, smallbitvec, euclid, and others for measuring heap usage of data structures.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Core crate for measuring heap memory usage of Rust data structures in a way that integrates with Firefox's memory reporting infrastructure. Provides shallow and deep measurement traits, support for interior pointers, and special handling for Arc and Rc types.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses macros extensively to generate trait implementations for standard library and third-party types, following a pattern common in Firefox's Rust codebase.

nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the servo_arc crate, a custom Arc implementation for Servo with optional serde, servo, and refcount logging features.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Custom fork of Arc for Servo without weak reference counting, supporting dynamically-sized types via HeaderSlice, thin arcs, static data references, and ArcUnion for type-erased discriminated unions.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensively uses unsafe Rust for manual memory management, custom allocator integration, and FFI for Gecko refcount logging.

nodes.name: MallocSizeOfOps
nodes.summary: Core struct holding function pointers for heap size measurement operations, including size_of_op, enclosing_size_of_op, and have_seen_ptr_op for interior pointer support and cycle detection.

nodes.name: MallocSizeOf
nodes.summary: Primary trait for deep heap usage measurement of data structures, measuring all descendant heap-allocated values.

nodes.name: MallocShallowSizeOf
nodes.summary: Trait for shallow heap measurement of immediate heap-allocated descendants, useful when deep measurement is not possible and iteration is needed.

nodes.name: MallocUnconditionalSizeOf
nodes.summary: Trait like MallocSizeOf for measuring types such as Arc and Rc that are known to be primary references and should always be measured.

nodes.name: MallocUnconditionalShallowSizeOf
nodes.summary: Combined trait for unconditional shallow size measurement of types like Arc that are primary references.

nodes.name: MallocConditionalSizeOf
nodes.summary: Trait for measuring types like Arc only when they have not been previously measured, to avoid double-counting shared references.

nodes.name: MallocConditionalShallowSizeOf
nodes.summary: Combined trait for conditional shallow measurement of types like Arc, measuring only if not previously seen.

nodes.name: Arc
nodes.summary: Custom atomically reference-counted smart pointer that does not support weak references, reducing storage overhead and atomic operations compared to std::sync::Arc.

nodes.name: UniqueArc
nodes.summary: Wrapper around Arc that guarantees unique ownership during construction, enabling safe mutable access before converting to a shared Arc.

nodes.name: HeaderSlice
nodes.summary: Dynamically-sized type combining a typed header with a variable-length slice of data, allocated as a single contiguous block within an Arc.

nodes.name: ArcBorrow
nodes.summary: Borrowed reference to an Arc that avoids incrementing the reference count, used for zero-overhead temporary access.

nodes.name: ArcUnion
nodes.summary: Type-erased discriminated union of two Arc types, storing either an Arc<A> or Arc<B> with a discriminator bit in the pointer alignment area.

nodes.name: ArcUnionBorrow
nodes.summary: Borrowed view into an ArcUnion, providing typed access to either variant without refcounting.

nodes.name: SharedMemoryBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder that manages writing values into a pre-allocated fixed-size shared memory buffer, handling alignment, padding, and duplicate tracking in debug builds.

nodes.name: ToShmem
nodes.summary: Trait for cloning a value into a form suitable for shared memory by redirecting heap allocations into a SharedMemoryBuilder buffer.

nodes.name: to_shmem_slice
nodes.summary: Writes all items from an iterator into a contiguous slice in the shared memory buffer and returns a pointer to the slice.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Build script entry point that reads static_atoms.txt and predefined counter style names, generates the Atom type via string_cache_codegen, and writes it to atom.rs in the output directory.
